**2026-05-16 — OpenAI / Databricks: GPT-5.5 enters enterprise agent workflows**

OpenAI said Databricks is using GPT-5.5 for enterprise agent workflows, citing a 46% error reduction versus GPT-5.4 in an agent-harness setting and first-over-50% accuracy on OfficeQA Pro.
